shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
rg -n \"spec anchor|specs/|validated by|VALIDATED_BY|tests.list\" .lore src specs package.json | head -100
sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"validateMessage|list_sessions\" src/transport/ws/*.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,100p' package.json
rg -n 'prettier|format' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,45p' CHANGELOG.md
ls scripts | rg 'reanchor|spec-links' || true
git diff --check
git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | rg "answers list_sessions|accepts a bare"
nl -ba src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts | rg "accepts a bare|validates and preserves"
git diff --check
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts
git diff --check
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md | sed -n '1,260p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/listSessionsValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts
git commit -m "feat(transport): validate session list pagination" && git push'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
branch_name=$(git branch --show-current)
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count "origin/${branch_name}...HEAD"'
